newsitem.title: USA: Cyrix files patent suit vs Intel.
newsitem.headline: Cyrix files patent suit vs Intel.

text.p: Cyrix Corp said Tuesday that it had filed a patent infringement suit against Intel Corp that covers Intel's Pentium, Pentium Pro and Pentium II microprocessors.
Cyrix said its suit, filed in the U.S. District Court for the Eastern District of Texas, that Intel products infringe on one or both of two patents issued to Cyrix earlier Tuesday.

The name of the patents are "Microprocessor with externally controllable power management" and "Pipelined processor with register renaming hardware to accommodate multiple size registers," said Cyrix spokesman Mark Lipscomb.
"This is the first we've heard about it and at this stage we have no comment on it," said Intel spokesman Chuck Mulloy.
In April Cyrix and Intel reached a settlement after Intel accused Cyrix and Advanced Micro Devices Inc of infringing on the MMX trademark for media enhancement technology.
